scope: Human interpretation of bibliographic and transport observations, not a complete content re-review or an independent truth assessment of every claim.

reviews.question: Automated citation helper returned mismatch
reviews.resolution: Crossref returns the same chapter title with a Chapter Nine prefix and publication date 19 January 2022. Preserve the recorded title and year; do not adopt the helper verdict as an established defect.
reviews.remaining_limit: Bibliographic agreement does not independently verify the chapter's ritual description. The Handle resolves to a repository record, not directly to PDF bytes.

reviews.question: ISBN helper resolves journal reviews of the cited books
reviews.resolution: Treat the helper rows as ambiguous book/review mappings. Do not attach the review DOI to the book or call the book a fabrication.
reviews.remaining_limit: Original-edition metadata and text still require the existing source-specific checks.

reviews.question: Catalogue metadata dates differ from linked/original editions
reviews.resolution: Retain the specific edition distinctions. SRC-0004 links a 1776 copy while its Open Library work record supplies 1801. SRC-0006 already distinguishes the lending-only 1946 printing from the linked transcription. A work-level date does not date every attached copy.
reviews.remaining_limit: No new full-copy collation was performed for these older sources.

reviews.question: Bound series/container metadata differs from the cited contribution
reviews.resolution: Keep these as review qualifications. The provider's broad title/date must not overwrite the cited contribution's title, editor or date without checking the appropriate title page or issue.
reviews.remaining_limit: A fresh title-page/issue collation was not completed for these two sources in this audit.

reviews.question: Online publication and paginated issue dates differ
reviews.resolution: The captured first page states online publication on 27 August 2024 and Aries 26 (2026), pp. 58–92. Existing original_year=2024 and edition_year=2026 are appropriate and are retained.
reviews.remaining_limit: Publication identity does not independently corroborate every historical assertion.

reviews.question: Archive metadata says 1930 while the inspected title page says 1929
reviews.resolution: Retain 1929 and the already recorded discrepancy. The archive catalogue date does not overrule the inspected title page.
reviews.remaining_limit: Historical translated testimony is not a present-practice assessment.

reviews.question: Automated subject-label review: Brahmanical (Vedic) tradition versus Brahmanism
reviews.resolution: Retain the mapping with its existing scope. A terminology difference alone does not establish a wrong identifier; no automatic relinking or claim upgrade follows.

reviews.question: Recorded caption derivative not found in the supplied capture directories
reviews.resolution: Retain the recorded digest and original inspection statement, but do not claim its bytes were revalidated during this audit.
reviews.remaining_limit: No public transcript-file URL is recorded. A new caption export could differ and would need its own copy identity.

reviews.question: A working collection page was previously treated as supporting a full disclosure
reviews.resolution: Recover the exact public index/archive routes but narrow unsupported seed extents to reference. Keep original exhibit and message recovery open. Link labels and domain destinations remain observations, not proof of a delivered ritual text.
reviews.remaining_limit: No full OT III exhibit or exact historical Usenet message recovered; authenticity and review labels remain qualified.

reviews.question: Circa-2017 collection reference conflated discussion, upload and recording dates
reviews.resolution: Replace it with an identifiable NewNameNoah endowment video. Local browser shows a 15 May 2013 upload; uploader describes footage from 2011 and 2012 and a separate veil segment. Record metadata-only inspection, not full footage or audio review.
reviews.remaining_limit: Uploader identity, recording provenance, editing and ritual coverage remain unassessed.

reviews.question: Recovered text is an edited transcription with several dated layers
reviews.resolution: Keep the 1692 trial year; identify the credited 1903 edition base and distinguish the 1691/1693 relation context. Selected text inspected without claiming original-manuscript collation.
reviews.remaining_limit: No independent origin or authenticity upgrade follows from finding another derivative of the same court record.

reviews.question: Finding aids and holdings improve recoverability but do not deliver source content
reviews.resolution: Retain the court record direct-route gap. Add the identified Sirr-i Akbar holding with explicit bibliographic-only notes; leave the Gallica reader uninspected.
reviews.remaining_limit: Neither court exhibits nor manuscript pages were recovered.

reviews.question: Browser-readable source coexists with HTTP client refusal
reviews.resolution: Update to the observed AustLII viewdoc URL and preserve the browser read separately from the HTTP 403 receipt.
reviews.remaining_limit: DOM inspection establishes readability in that session, without an invented successful HTTP response code.

implementation_notes: The initial metadata parser collected nested SVG title elements along with the document title. The parser was corrected and regression-tested; old observations are preserved as title_elements_text with their original auditor hash and parser label.
HTTP 200 human-verification pages and HTTP 202 nonfinal responses remain access qualifications.
Original and edition dates are compared without treating first-online publication, upload dates or bracketed catalogue years as automatic errors.
Provider access failures remain unresolved observations. They do not establish that the sources are dead, censored or false.
No source-authenticity, claim-support, review-status or modern-practice label was promoted by this audit.
Discovery logs now validate recovery roles, source IDs and outcomes and are included with their own input hashes. Unsearched routes are distinct from unsuccessful queries.
The original 52 Open Library failures group to one host and 26 source records. A browser and HTTP refusal do not establish an outage cause or 52 missing works.
An explicit single-host retry of PDFCoffee again failed DNS resolution; its original receipt remains in previous_observations.
